与购物一起成长(Growing up with shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的B1记叙文:米娅的经历、感受与成长。
Mia believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Little by little, things began to change. Mia wrote down every idea in a small notebook. What a pretty dress!

The experience taught Mia more than any book could. Amy and Mia are preparing a report about the book store. The supermarket has become an important part of daily life. Best of all, the rich businessman gave money to schools.

People around Mia often share different ideas about the book store. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Amy always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Check the size guide, not the label.

Mia thanked Amy for the honest advice. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Mia keeps a small cat at home and feeds it every morning. In fact, the landfill site closed after thirty years.
Mia usually spends the weekend reading at the library. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. On Monday evenings, Mia reviews the notes from class.
